value.rationale: Simultaneously preserves every quantifier-rank/finite-variable equivalence relation across a natural nonabelian finite-index extension, not merely one numerical example. Transfers all rank and pebble-width lower/upper bounds for noncyclic odd finite abelian groups to generally nonabelian generalized dihedral groups, and also applies to torsion-free infinite kernels. The precisely needed qf-definability condition and exact preservation of both logical resources supply structural leverage beyond the known cyclic lemma.
